headline: Run Massive MoE Models on Consumer Hardware
lede: Colibrì redefines model deployment by treating local storage as a unified memory hierarchy. It JIT-compiles weight streaming to run multi-trillion parameter architectures on everyday hardware.

headline: Unify Your Business Ecosystem With Ever Gauzy
lede: Ever Gauzy replaces fragmented SaaS subscriptions with a modular, self-hosted platform. Its API-first architecture integrates CRM, ERP, and project management into a single, scalable deployment.

headline: Visualize Real-Time World Movement in 3D
lede: God's Eye View aggregates public beacon data into a seamless, browser-based globe. The platform renders complex movement patterns with tactical sensor overlays for an immersive investigative experience.

headline: Secure Your AI Agents With Verified Skills
lede: This registry standardizes modular skillsets for coding agents while enforcing strict security protocols. By vetting instructions at the source, it closes the trust gap in AI-assisted development.

headline: Deploy a Sovereign WhatsApp CRM via Docker
lede: DeskcommCRM removes vendor lock-in by placing sales automation under your full control. Its automated deployment scripts simplify infrastructure management for privacy-conscious teams.

headline: Automate Professional Video Production With Agentic Systems
lede: OpenMontage turns standard LLMs into a full-scale studio for asset generation and cinematic editing. This project explores the intersection of creative workflows and autonomous multi-agent orchestration.

headline: Archive the Hidden Instructional Layers of Modern LLMs
lede: This repository catalogs verbatim system prompts to preserve a historical record of model guardrails. Researchers can now analyze the behavioral evolution of major foundation models over time.

headline: Execute Autonomous Penetration Testing in Sandboxed Environments
lede: PentAGI leverages multi-agent logic to automate security assessments while maintaining strict data sovereignty. It transforms manual vulnerability discovery into an observable, self-hosted testing cycle.

headline: Compose and Edit Music With Symbolic AI Planning
lede: YuE2 enables precise control over generative audio by using a transparent, symbolic planning stage. Developers can refine output through natural language while maintaining the flexibility of editable scores.

headline: SmartTube Reaches Over 30,000 Stars on GitHub
lede: SmartTube continues to grow as the premier ad-free alternative for Android TV power users. Its ability to bypass promotional content while maintaining high-fidelity playback remains a community favorite.
